notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Our team worked quickly on a small update:

Limited FPS.

Fixed bugs with weapons: they now remain consistent when moving to another location and do not drop without reason.

Added a progress icon to the burner, making it easier to work with.

Corrected the text in the Bus Customizer.

Enlarged G! He's a big boy now

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/0ca05462da4a1ca43a550ffc0bf13826101fec02.gif

Thank you very much for your support and feedback :) Also, we have a small request for you - do not stop writing to us. If you have caught a bug or you have an idea, or maybe you have made a cool video about your adventure with friends - send everything! This helps us understand how to make the game even more interesting.

Don't forget to download the update!
